text: The proxy sign-in redirected to the wrong host after the callback, so every login loop ended on a 404.
rootCause: The callback URL was built from the internal host header instead of the public one.

text: The acceptance test for the board failed one run in five because it clicked before the card had rendered.
rootCause: It waited a fixed time instead of waiting for the locator.

text: The semantic search ranked unrelated items first because the query used the passage prefix.
rootCause: The embedding model needs different prefixes for queries and passages.

text: The migration added a NOT NULL column without a default and failed on the staging copy of the data.
rootCause: The migration was only run on the empty test database.

text: The brief did not say which tests define done, so the agent stopped at green unit tests and skipped the acceptance run.
rootCause: Acceptance criteria were written as prose, not as test names.

text: Builds waited on the shared host lock for twenty minutes while three agents queued behind a full test run.
rootCause: One agent ran the whole suite instead of its own filter.

text: Keeping each pull request to one slice made the review quick and the rollbacks trivial.
Sessions expired after a few minutes behind the proxy and users were signed out mid-edit.
rootCause: The cookie was set for the internal domain, so the browser dropped it.

text: The CI run took 40 minutes because the screenshot tests re-ran from scratch on every retry.
Falling back to lexical search when the model is missing meant the feature still worked on the small host.
Run every migration against a copy of production-sized data before the merge.
Two tasks owned the same file because the plan never listed who edits the shared fixture.
rootCause: File ownership was implied, not written down.

text: The laptop ran out of memory when two real-model tests loaded the embedding model at once.
Reviewers caught the access check gap because the diff was small enough to read in full.
Test the sign-in flow through the real proxy before merging any auth change.
Quarantine a flaky test the first time it fails and open an issue instead of re-running the pipeline.
Reindexing the whole corpus after the model changed took an hour and blocked the host.
rootCause: Vectors from the old model were still stored with no record of which model made them.

text: Two branches both added migration 0910 and the second one failed to apply after the merge.
rootCause: Migration numbers are picked by hand with no check for duplicates.

text: Every brief should name the files it owns and the tests that define done.
Cap the number of agents running builds at three and run heavy model tests alone.
Splitting the work by lane let three agents merge without a single conflict.
The forwarded-proto header was missing, so the OAuth redirect used http and the identity provider rejected it.
rootCause: The proxy did not forward the scheme.

text: A test passed locally but failed in CI since the timezone differed between the two machines.
rootCause: The test used the local clock rather than a fixed time provider.

text: Store the model name next to every embedding so a model swap is detected, not guessed.
A schema change dropped an index that a report query depended on, and the report timed out.
We had to add a contract field mid-wave because the design showed data the contract did not carry.
A build timed out at the 300 second cap because another process held the lock.
Writing the contract first meant the client and server met in the middle without rework.
Once we logged the callback request, finding the bad sign-in redirect took ten minutes.
We spent half a day chasing a flaky end-to-end test that turned out to share a database with another test.
Search results for short queries were noisy; a two-word query matched almost everything above the cut-off.
rootCause: The similarity cut-off was tuned on long sentences.

text: The schema tests caught the missing foreign key before review.
The agent guessed the meaning of the empty state because the brief only linked a screen.
rootCause: The screen had no copy for the empty case.
